title: MAX_LINE_BYTES checked before CRLF strip: exceeds RFC 3977 512-byte limit by 2
description: In session/command.rs, MAX_LINE_BYTES = 512 is compared against the raw line length before the trailing CRLF is stripped. RFC 3977 §3.1.3 states the 512-byte limit includes the CRLF terminator. The current code therefore allows a command line of 512 bytes plus a 2-byte CRLF = 514 wire bytes, which is 2 bytes over the RFC limit. Fix: either compare against the post-strip length (correct), or set MAX_LINE_BYTES = 510 (preserves the current stripping order but stays within the RFC).
